create_moolib_rpc_instance: create a moolib.Rpc instance to act as an RPC client or host
define_rpc_function: define a remote callable function on an Rpc host using define
run_sync_rpc_call: run a synchronous RPC call to a remote host and get the result
run_async_rpc_call: run an asynchronous RPC call that returns a Future for later result retrieval
run_async_callback_rpc: run an async RPC call with a callback function for response and error handling
